name: Unreal Engine
description: Real-time 3D engine powering in-camera VFX (ICVFX), LED volume stages, MegaLights, and Live Link Hub. UE 5.8 was released in June 2026 as the final planned major UE5 release; UE6 early access is targeted for late 2027.
longDescription: Epic Games' Unreal Engine is the core technology powering modern virtual production stages. UE 5.8 was released in June 2026, introducing production-ready MegaLights, Lumen Lite for 60 fps targets, experimental Mesh Terrain, and Live Link Hub tracking synchronization. Early access for Unreal Engine 6 is scheduled for late 2027.

name: Topaz Video
description: AI video enhancement, temporal de-flickering, Starlight diffusion restoration, and Neurostream local device inference.
longDescription: Topaz Video (formerly Topaz Video AI) bridges the critical quality gap between synthetic generative video and professional 4K cinematography with local desktop diffusion models. Adobe completed the acquisition of Topaz Labs on 23 Sep 2026, for about $340M, primarily cash, integrating Neurostream and video enhancement models into Creative Cloud workflows.

name: Nuke
description: Industry-standard node-based compositing software featuring native 3D Gaussian Splatting, CopyCat ML, and USD workflows.
longDescription: Foundry released Nuke 17.0 on 26 Feb 2026, bringing native 3D Gaussian Splatting support, USD 3D system out of beta, and CopyCat neural networks.

name: Blender
description: Open-source 3D creation suite featuring procedural physics in Geometry Nodes, texture caching in Cycles, and Grease Pencil enhancements.
longDescription: Blender 5.2 LTS brings procedural hair and cloth simulation directly into Geometry Nodes, alongside texture caching optimizations in Cycles and enhanced asset library remote hosting.
features: Cycles GPU Path Tracing with Texture Caching

name: DaVinci Resolve
description: Premier Hollywood color grading, editing, Fusion VFX, and Fairlight audio post-production suite.
longDescription: Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve 21.1.1 combines neural isolation brushes, HDR Dolby Vision mastering, Fusion node VFX, and Cloud Multi-Seat Collaboration with AI assistant integration in both a free tier and professional Studio edition.
features: DaVinci Neural Engine AI Masking & Assistants

name: Houdini
description: Procedural 3D animation and effects software featuring native 3D Gaussian Splatting, Copernicus GPU image processing, and KineFX character animation.
longDescription: SideFX released Houdini 22 on 16 Jul 2026, delivering native 3D Gaussian Splatting editing and relighting, the Copernicus GPU image processor for textures and terrains, Solaris USD enhancements, and expanded KineFX rigging.
features: 3D Gaussian Splatting (create, edit, rig, relight, render)

name: Runway
description: Multimodal AI video generation platform with director controls, camera trajectories, and studio partnerships.
longDescription: Runway offers director-level camera controls, multi-character consistency, and cinematic framing through its Gen-4.5 architecture released in December 2025.

name: Adobe After Effects
description: Industry-standard motion graphics, title design, and visual effects compositing with native 3D workspace.
longDescription: Adobe After Effects is the essential motion design and visual effects software, featuring advanced 3D workspace integration, AI Roto Brush, and deep Creative Cloud pipeline hooks.

name: Autodesk Maya
description: Industry-standard 3D animation, rigging, character modeling, and simulation platform powering Hollywood feature animation.
longDescription: Autodesk released Maya 2027 on 25 Mar 2026 and Maya 2027.1 on 21 May 2026, introducing OTIO support in Sequencer, LookdevX 2.1.0 texture projections, USD for Maya 0.36, and Smart Bevel enhancements.

name: Autodesk ShotGrid
description: Production tracking, review, and asset management software powering collaborative pipelines across global VFX facilities.
longDescription: Autodesk ShotGrid provides production management, review, and pipeline integration for creative studios worldwide, connecting artists, supervisors, and producers in real-time.

name: Higgsfield AI Video
description: Generative video platform with granular 3D camera trajectory controls and photorealistic human motion.
longDescription: Higgsfield AI is the generative video platform engineered for directors, previs artists, and cinematographers, offering granular 3D camera trajectory controls, realistic human motion kinematics, and custom scene direction.
features: Cinematic Pan, Tilt, Dolly & Boom Moves

name: ElevenLabs Cinema Voice AI
description: Hyper-realistic AI voice acting, automated dialogue replacement (ADR), and sound effects generation.
longDescription: ElevenLabs delivers studio-grade voice performances, automated dialogue replacement (ADR), and synthetic Foley sound effects with nuanced emotional control for cinema, gaming, and commercial localization.
